title: Hugging Face Releases LeRobot v0.6.0
summary: Hugging Face shipped LeRobot v0.6.0 on July 7, 2026, its largest update yet to the open-source robot-learning toolkit, organized around the themes "imagine, evaluate, improve." The release adds three world-model policies (VLA-JEPA, FastWAM, LingBot-VA), five new VLA integrations (GR00T N1.7, MolmoAct2, EO-1, EVO1, Multitask DiT), and a new reward-model API (Robometer, TOPReward, SARM). It unifies six simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-plus, RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, RoboCerebra, RoboMME, VLABench) behind a single lerobot-eval CLI, and adds a lerobot-rollout deployment CLI supporting DAgger-style correction workflows. It also adds end-to-end depth-sensing support for Intel RealSense cameras and roughly 2x faster multi-camera video data loading.
whyItMatters: LeRobot is the de facto open-source standard toolkit for robot-learning research, so consolidating new world-model policies, a growing set of VLA integrations, and six benchmarks behind one evaluation and deployment CLI meaningfully lowers the friction of reproducing and comparing robot-learning methods across labs, likely accelerating adoption of world-model-based approaches across the field.
